error_path.derivation: NFLlib.cpp:300 masks each PRNG word to 9 low bits (0..511); lines311-313 subtract399 once if >=399. Values below399 are0..398; reduced values are0..112. Hence every pre-NTT integer error coefficient is in0..398. This deterministic range does not assume PRNG distribution quality.
error_path.crt: NFLlib.cpp:317 copies the same integer into both residue arrays. Since398 is below both primes, their common canonical CRT lift is that same nonnegative integer.
error_path.centering: NFLLWE.cpp:315 subtraction of (Berr-1)*2^w is commented out. Do not call this symmetric[-199,199] noise or use Emax199/200.
error_path.amplification: NFLLWE.cpp:590-602 recomputeNoiseAmplifiers constructs2^w modulo each prime using GMP; enc line312 multiplies error by that amplifier and line318 adds plaintext; line332 applies negacyclic NTT; lines335-355 sample a and add a*s.
error_path.distribution_boundary: This is not a Gaussian sampler. Mask-and-subtract399 is biased even if low9 bits are uniform. The uniform=true key/a branch also uses masking and one subtraction. This audit does not identify it with the formal uniform law or establish IND-CPA/joint independence.
